title: Sửa modal tạo mẫu bàn trên điện thoại
rootCause: CustomTableModelBuilderModal currently renders a legacy DOM contract while Table3DSimulatorModal.scss styles the newer builder contract. The modal is auto-wrapped by the shared Modal, tab buttons miss their component classes, form controls miss local classes, and the phone breakpoint stacks all four modes into one long column. This causes the title, close control, tabs, fields and scrolling region to stretch or overlap on 390-430px screens.
